title: Midnight cannot be persisted as the legacy scheduled hour
reasoning: setScheduledHour accepts 0 as valid, but getScheduledHour treats any stored integer value of 0 as missing and returns the default 6. Users or legacy callers cannot set a midnight schedule even though the setter validates it as allowed.
reproduction: Call setScheduledHour(0), then getScheduledHour(); the result is 6 instead of 0.
recommendation: Use object(forKey:) to distinguish an absent value from a stored 0, matching the pattern already used for minWordCount and showNotifications.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: SettingsRepositoryTests only verifies the default and setting hour 14; it does not test the valid boundary value 0.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend testScheduledHour with setScheduledHour(0) and expect getScheduledHour() == 0.
